metadata.title: Keyboard Mapping Dispatch: constructor Own-Property Bypass and Function-Type Dispatch Without Restriction

sources: ApplinX REST API CreateSessionResponse/GetInfoResponse keyboardMapping array
transformations: Server-supplied targetFunction parsed as string or function object
methodName extracted via indexOf substring parsing

privilege_boundary.achieved_privilege: None — all dispatch paths blocked by hasOwnProperty guard

impact.description: The hasOwnProperty guard correctly blocks prototype-chain traversal. constructor is an inherited property, not own — guard returns false. JSFunctionsService has no own-property methods. JSON cannot serialize functions. No impact is possible via this attack path.

compensating_controls: JSFunctionsService has no exploitable own-property methods

remediation.fix_approach: No fix required. Defense-in-depth: add explicit method allowlist in KeyboardMappingService; add JSDoc API_MISUSE_RISK warning to IJSFunctionService interface.

history.note: R-H-003: VULN-002 own-property guard bypassed by 'constructor' property; function-type targetFunction dispatch is unrestricted

constructor is NOT an own property — hasOwnProperty returns false for inherited properties. JSON cannot serialize functions. No own-property methods exist on JSFunctionsService. All claimed attack paths are blocked.
